description: A pure sine oscillator built for FM, sixteen voices polyphonic, with every parameter of a DX7 style operator on the panel. A blue lamp marks it as a modulator, a purple lamp as a carrier

params.text: Sets the octave of the base frequency
Shifts the base frequency in semitones
Shifts the base frequency continuously over plus or minus one semitone
A ratio applied to the tuned frequency, as a DX7 operator's ratio is
How much of the phase input reaches the start phase
Sets the phase the oscillator starts from, in degrees
How much of the exponential FM input reaches the pitch
Sets the modulation index, the depth at which the linear FM inputs modulate the frequency
How much of the modulation index input reaches the modulation index
Sets how much of the oscillator's own output is fed back into it; the menu chooses between two kinds of feedback
How much of the feedback input reaches the feedback level
How much of the output level input reaches the output level
Cuts off the tuning voltage arriving from the operator this one is chained to, so it keeps its own tuning; a yellow lamp lights while it is cut off

inputs.text: A polyphonic pitch input at 1V per octave
A voltage moving the start phase
A pulse resets the phase to the value set by PHASE
A clock here sets the base frequency, so an external device can drive the tuning
A voltage modulating the pitch exponentially
A voltage modulating the modulation index
One of five signals modulating the frequency linearly, five because a DX7 operator takes five modulators; the depth is set by MOD INDEX
A voltage modulating the feedback level
A voltage modulating the output level

notes: the frequency display can be typed into, and takes a tempo such as 120 bpm as well as a frequency
placed immediately to the right of another TZOP, the module becomes its modulator with no patching
as a modulator it reads the pitch voltage of the operator on its left and sends its own output into that operator's linear FM input
menu: Reset Base Phase for all voices — puts every voice back to the same start phase
Use Correlated Feedback — picks the second of the two kinds of feedback
Detach is a FULL Detach from CARRIER/MODULATOR — makes DETACH break the whole carrier and modulator link rather than only the incoming tuning
Randomize Base Phase for voices 10% and Randomize Base Phase for voices 20% — spread the sixteen voices' start phases by that much
